trades.name: LBAF of 23745 holding today's low
trades.quote: If NQ is imply going to rally direct, I would like to see dips near 23745 aggressively bought. Any kind of LBAF of this spot that holds today’s low targets 785 with potential for another crack at today’s high. Building volume above today’s high targets the major weekly 869-885 spot.

trades.name: Fail to sustain above 23824-23831 (incl. today's high)

trades.name: LBAF of today's low (23719)
trades.quote: I’ll reiterate that one more push below today’s low on NQ is still a long with serious potential. I believe sellers need to cap 23700-23724 as UPside to trigger a fresh liquidation.

trades.name: LAAF of 6475-6477 (incl. today's high)
trades.quote: A LAAF of 6475-6477 (inclusive of today’s high, the overnight breakdown level, and Friday’s VPOC) could very likely trigger a bearish engulfing day on ES, especially if the 6470 seller pops back in the tape. I think if ES tests higher first and fails in this manner (particularly during RTH), then my NQ long runners are at risk and ES will be under pressure to hold a proper 6451-6454 test.
